subsection.title: Simplify a Complex Rational Expression by Writing it as Division
subsection.p: Complex fractions are fractions in which the numerator or denominator contains a fraction. We previously simplified complex fractions like these:
In this section, we will simplify complex rational expressions, which are rational expressions with rational expressions in the numerator or denominator.

note.p: A complex rational expression is a rational expression in which the numerator and/or the denominator contains a rational expression.

subsection.p: Here are a few complex rational expressions:
Remember, we always exclude values that would make any denominator zero.
We will use two methods to simplify complex rational expressions.
We have already seen this complex rational expression earlier in this chapter.
We noted that fraction bars tell us to divide, so rewrote it as the division problem:
Then, we multiplied the first rational expression by the reciprocal of the second, just like we do when we divide two fractions.

This is one method to simplify complex rational expressions. We make sure the complex rational expression is of the form where one fraction is over one fraction. We then write it as if we were dividing two fractions.

problem.p: Simplify the complex rational expression by writing it as division: $$\frac{\frac{6}{x - 4}}{\frac{3}{x^{2} - 16}}.$$

table.summary: Step-by-step simplification of a complex rational expression involving algebraic terms.

row.cell: Rewrite the complex fraction as division.
Rewrite as the product of first times thereciprocal of the second.

solution.p: Are there any value(s) of x that should not be allowed? The original complex rational expression had denominators of $$x - 4$$ and $$x^{2} - 16.$$ This expression would be undefined if $$x = 4$$ or $$x = -4.$$

note.p: Simplify the complex rational expression by writing it as division: $$\frac{\frac{2}{x^{2} - 1}}{\frac{3}{x + 1}}.$$
Simplify the complex rational expression by writing it as division: $$\frac{\frac{1}{x^{2} - 7x + 12}}{\frac{2}{x - 4}}.$$

subsection.p: Fraction bars act as grouping symbols. So to follow the Order of Operations, we simplify the numerator and denominator as much as possible before we can do the division.

problem.p: Simplify the complex rational expression by writing it as division: $$\frac{\frac{1}{3} + \frac{1}{6}}{\frac{1}{2} - \frac{1}{3}}.$$

Rewrite the complex rational expression as a divisionproblem.
Multiply the first by the reciprocal of the second.

Simplify the complex rational expression by writing it as division: $$\frac{\frac{3}{4} - \frac{1}{3}}{\frac{1}{8} + \frac{5}{6}}.$$

subsection.p: We follow the same procedure when the complex rational expression contains variables.

problem.p: Simplify the complex rational expression by writing it as division: $$\frac{\frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{y}}{\frac{x}{y} - \frac{y}{x}}.$$

Simplify the complex rational expression by writing it as division: $$\frac{\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b}}{\frac{1}{a^{2}} - \frac{1}{b^{2}}}$$.

problem.p: Simplify the complex rational expression by writing it as division: $$\frac{n - \frac{4n}{n + 5}}{\frac{1}{n + 5} + \frac{1}{n - 5}}.$$

subsection.title: Simplify a Complex Rational Expression by Using the LCD
subsection.p: We “cleared” the fractions by multiplying by the LCD when we solved equations with fractions. We can use that strategy here to simplify complex rational expressions. We will multiply the numerator and denominator by the LCD of all the rational expressions.

Let’s look at the complex rational expression we simplified one way in Example 7.25. We will simplify it here by multiplying the numerator and denominator by the LCD. When we multiply by $$\frac{\text{LCD}}{\text{LCD}}$$ we are multiplying by 1, so the value stays the same.

problem.p: Simplify the complex rational expression by using the LCD: $$\frac{\frac{1}{3} + \frac{1}{6}}{\frac{1}{2} - \frac{1}{3}}.$$

row.cell: The LCD of all the fractions in the whole expression is 6.
Clear the fractions by multiplying the numerator anddenominator by that LCD.

note.p: Simplify the complex rational expression by using the LCD: $$\frac{\frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{5}}{\frac{1}{10} + \frac{1}{5}}.$$
Simplify the complex rational expression by using the LCD: $$\frac{\frac{1}{4} + \frac{3}{8}}{\frac{1}{2} - \frac{5}{16}}.$$

subsection.p: We will use the same example as in Example 7.26. Decide which method works better for you.

problem.p: Simplify the complex rational expression by using the LCD: $$\frac{\frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{y}}{\frac{x}{y} - \frac{y}{x}}.$$

note.p: Simplify the complex rational expression by using the LCD: $$\frac{\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b}}{\frac{a}{b} + \frac{b}{a}}.$$
Simplify the complex rational expression by using the LCD: $$\frac{\frac{1}{x^{2}} - \frac{1}{y^{2}}}{\frac{1}{x} + \frac{1}{y}}.$$

list.item: Step 1. Find the LCD of all fractions in the complex rational expression.
Step 2. Multiply the numerator and denominator by the LCD.

subsection.p: Be sure to start by factoring all the denominators so you can find the LCD.

problem.p: Simplify the complex rational expression by using the LCD: $$\frac{\frac{2}{x + 6}}{\frac{4}{x - 6} - \frac{4}{x^{2} - 36}}.$$

row.cell: Find the LCD of all fractions in the complex rationalexpression. The LCD is $$x^{2} - 36 = (x + 6)(x - 6)$$.
Multiply the numerator and denominator by the LCD.
To simplify the denominator, distributeand combine like terms.
Notice that there are no more factorscommon to the numerator and denominator.

note.p: Simplify the complex rational expression by using the LCD: $$\frac{\frac{3}{x + 2}}{\frac{5}{x - 2} - \frac{3}{x^{2} - 4}}.$$
Simplify the complex rational expression by using the LCD: $$\frac{\frac{2}{x - 7} - \frac{1}{x + 7}}{\frac{6}{x + 7} - \frac{1}{x^{2} - 49}}.$$

subsection.p: Be sure to factor the denominators first. Proceed carefully as the math can get messy!

problem.p: Simplify the complex rational expression by using the LCD: $$\frac{\frac{4}{m^{2} - 7m + 12}}{\frac{3}{m - 3} - \frac{2}{m - 4}}.$$

Simplify the complex rational expression by using the LCD: $$\frac{\frac{4y}{y + 5} + \frac{2}{y + 6}}{\frac{3y}{y^{2} + 11y + 30}}.$$

problem.p: Simplify the complex rational expression by using the LCD: $$\frac{\frac{y}{y + 1}}{1 + \frac{1}{y - 1}}.$$

row.cell: Find the LCD of all fractions in the complex rational expression.
Multiply the numerator and denominator by the LCD.
Distribute in the denominator and simplify.
Simplify the denominator and leave thenumerator factored.
Factor the denominator and remove factorscommon with the numerator.

problem.p: In this section, you learned to simplify the complex fraction $$\frac{\frac{3}{x + 2}}{\frac{x}{x^{2} - 4}}$$ two ways: rewriting it as a division problem or multiplying the numerator and denominator by the LCD. Which method do you prefer? Why?

Efraim wants to start simplifying the complex fraction $$\frac{\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b}}{\frac{1}{a} - \frac{1}{b}}$$ by cancelling the variables from the numerator and denominator, $$\frac{\frac{1}{a} + \frac{1}{b}}{\frac{1}{a} - \frac{1}{b}}.$$ Explain what is wrong with Efraim’s plan.
